# Repositori Universitas Kristen Indonesia

> Institutional digital repository for Universitas Kristen Indonesia's academic publications, theses, and research outputs using EPrints 3 software.

This repository serves as the central archive for scholarly works produced by UKI's faculty, researchers, and students across all academic divisions. It provides open access to institutional research and supports OAI-compliant metadata harvesting for broader academic discovery.

## Key Topics

- Universitas Kristen Indonesia
- institutional repository

## Browse & Discover

- [Browse by Subject](http://repository.uki.ac.id/view/subjects): Browse repository content by Library of Congress Classification subjects.
- [Browse by Division and Year](http://repository.uki.ac.id/view/divisions): Browse publications by university divisions and faculties including economics, law, and medicine.
- [Browse by Year](http://repository.uki.ac.id/view/year): Browse academic publications and theses by publication year.
- [Browse by Author](http://repository.uki.ac.id/view/creators): Alphabetical index of authors and creators in the institutional repository.
- [Latest Additions](http://repository.uki.ac.id/cgi/latest): Latest additions to the repository showing recent academic publications.
- [Latest 20 Additions](http://repository.uki.ac.id/cgi/latest_tool): Display of 20 most recently added academic publications and theses.
